mapper.select: select a.id as contractId, a.contract_code as contractCode, a.biz_dept_id as belongDeptId, ifnull(b.pay_amount,0) as payAmount, ifnull(c.first_rent_amount,0) as firstRentAmount from contract_base_info as a inner join ( select contract_id, sum(paid_in_amount) as pay_amount from payment_actual_detail where paid_in_date >= #{startDate} and paid_in_date <= #{endDate} group by contract_id ) as b on a.id = b.contract_id left join ( select contract_id, sum(collection_amount) as first_rent_amount from collection_base_info where cash_flow_item = 'FIRST_RENT' group by contract_id ) as c on a.id = c.contract_id

select a.id as contractId, a.contract_code as contractCode, a.biz_dept_id as belongDeptId, ifnull(b.pay_amount,0) as payAmount, ifnull(c.first_rent_amount,0) as firstRentAmount, ifnull(d.principal_amount,0) as principalAmount from contract_base_info as a inner join ( select contract_id, sum(paid_in_amount) as pay_amount from payment_actual_detail group by contract_id ) as b on a.id = b.contract_id left join ( select contract_id, sum(collection_amount) as first_rent_amount from collection_base_info where cash_flow_item = 'FIRST_RENT' group by contract_id ) as c on a.id = c.contract_id left join ( select contract_id, sum(collection_principal) as principal_amount from collection_base_info where cash_flow_item = 'RENT' and phase > 0 and collection_date <= #{targetDate} group by contract_id ) as d on a.id = d.contract_id where a.contract_status in ('TAKE_EFFECT','START_RENT')
